question: The study of viruses is called ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**virology**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• A Virus is an **infectious agent** that replicates only inside the living cells of an organism.

 
 
• The virus was discovered by **Dmitri Ivanovsky**.
 
• The **tobacco mosaic virus** is the first discovered virus.
